theory.title: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before
theory.explanation: Usa conjunciones temporales para indicar cuándo ocurre una acción en relación con otra. Cuando hablas del futuro, utiliza el presente simple después de as soon as, once, until y before: I'll call you as soon as I arrive (te llamaré en cuanto llegue).
theory.tip: Para hablar del futuro, usa present simple después de as soon as / once / until / before.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 1
patterns.pattern: I'll go to bed as soon as I finish this chapter.
examples:
I'll go to bed as soon as I finish this chapter.
→ Me iré a la cama en cuanto termine este capítulo.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 2
patterns.pattern: Once you feel better, you can return to exercise.
examples:
Once you feel better, you can return to exercise.
→ Cuando te encuentres mejor, podrás volver a hacer ejercicio.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 3
patterns.pattern: Wait here until the doctor calls your name.
examples:
Wait here until the doctor calls your name.
→ Espera aquí hasta que el médico diga tu nombre.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 4
patterns.pattern: Wash your hands before you prepare food.
examples:
Wash your hands before you prepare food.
→ Lávate las manos antes de preparar la comida.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 5
patterns.pattern: I'll start the workout after I warm up.
examples:
I'll start the workout after I warm up.
→ Empezaré el entrenamiento después de calentar.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 6
patterns.pattern: As soon as the appointment ends, I'll call you.
examples:
As soon as the appointment ends, I'll call you.
→ Te llamaré en cuanto termine la cita.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 7
patterns.pattern: Don't leave until the nurse gives you instructions.
examples:
Don't leave until the nurse gives you instructions.
→ No te vayas hasta que la enfermera te dé instrucciones.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 8
patterns.pattern: Once the routine becomes familiar, it feels easier.
examples:
Once the routine becomes familiar, it feels easier.
→ Cuando la rutina se vuelva familiar, resultará más fácil.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 9
patterns.pattern: Drink some water before you go running.
examples:
Drink some water before you go running.
→ Bebe agua antes de salir a correr.

patterns.label: Oraciones temporales con as soon as, once, until y before · 10
patterns.pattern: We'll discuss the results when the doctor arrives.
examples:
We'll discuss the results when the doctor arrives.
→ Comentaremos los resultados cuando llegue el médico.

content.passage: The nurse explained how to prepare for a check-up. Before you arrive, complete the online form and bring a list of medicines. Wait in reception until the nurse calls your name. Once the appointment begins, the doctor will ask about your routine. As soon as the examination finishes, you can ask questions. You should not return to intense exercise until the doctor gives you advice.

items.prompt: Describe what you do before you go to bed.
items.modelAnswer: I think looking after your health is about building realistic habits and making balanced choices. I try to stay active, drink enough water and get regular sleep. When I feel stressed, I take a break or go for a walk. It is important to follow medical advice and ask questions when something is unclear. Small changes can make a big difference over time, especially when people keep practising them.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
